findings.claim: The diff changes the existing test file addons/intelligence/tests/test_z_pickup_evaluate.py, which is not among the existing tests the touch-point list names as updated (test_z_pickup_accuracy_worker.py, test_z_pickup_worker.py, test_z_pickup_retrieval.py, test_z_pickup_feed.py, test_z_pickup_evaluate_after.py).
findings.impact: No user-facing effect. A reviewer who trusts the touch-point list would not check whether this existing assertion was weakened. The edit replaces an exact row-list check with a check that strips '*' from each row name before comparing to the expected list, so it no longer pins which row, if any, carries the mark. The new test test_z_pickup_recency_replay.py::test_spec_addon_102_replay_reports_the_grid_rows_in_order checks the mark separately, so coverage is not lost overall.
findings.evidence: In addons/intelligence/tests/test_z_pickup_evaluate.py, around lines 162-172 of test_spec_addon_098_i9_replay_scores_each_configuration, the old assertion `assert list(rows) == ["before", "depth", "video", "after", "random", "newest"]` becomes `assert [name.rstrip("*") for name in rows] == expected`, where `expected` now also lists the eight fresh_h*_f* rows. The touch-point list and spec §7 list five existing tests, and this file is not one of them.

bucket_proposal.reason: An unlisted touch point. It breaks no declared invariant: the test was updated because replay gained rows, which SPEC-ADDON-102 step 8 requires.

findings.proposed_fix: Add test_z_pickup_evaluate.py to the §7 and touch-point list of existing tests updated, because it pins the replay row list.

potential_unspecified_behavior: test_z_pickup_accuracy_worker.py is listed only for updates 'where they pin version 3'. The diff also changes the fixtures of the SPEC-ADDON-095 I5 test (test_spec_addon_095_i5_the_checkpoint_ignores_row_order_and_float_noise) to give files a fixed created_at, because the arrival stamp now carries MAX(created_at). The file is listed, but the reason for this edit is not.
regression_risks: The checkpoint now includes the raw text of MAX(files.created_at). So the checkpoint can differ between runs that hold the same data written with different timestamps. This is intended, but it is a new dependency of the 095 I5 test.
test_coverage: The '*' mark on the replay row list is pinned by test_z_pickup_recency_replay.py, not by test_z_pickup_evaluate.py, which now strips the mark.
